title: ilex subavenia
intro: Ilex subavenia, commonly known as the Japanese holly, is a species of flowering plant in the family Aquifoliaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ilex subavenia include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate pain, while also acting as a diuretic and a mild laxative. The bioactive constituents of Ilex subavenia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
